description: The T-Rex body only works standing on both legs: M-57 clips to one hip and M-59 to the other, each leg standing on two floor cells in a line, side by side under the body. It behaves as the body: it catches marbles flying off a ramp lip and lets them out down the tail.

evidence.shows: both legs clip to the hips, feet two cells long on the floor, body between them
origin midpoint between the feet; hip clips at y +1 and -1

assumptions: Coordinates are the M-58 frame shifted half a cell so each leg's two foot cells sit on whole cells, as in T-Rex Levels 1 and 2.
The legs may stand on equal block stacks to raise the body, as Level 2 does by one slot.
